'''WED-15 Septoid Treadwells''' were a series of droids that resembled the insect [[Septoid/Legends|Septoid]]. They had a number of [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[4-DOF robotic arms]] that spidered out and multi-range photoreceptors.
